To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) an artificial, 12-mer protein ring is engineered to contain 120 cysteine residues; (ii) the protein ring assembles into a cage-like structure by coordination to Au(i); (iii) this structure is the largest protein cage reported to date, and is the first example of an artificial protein cage with a cubic symmetry.
we have created a protein cage with a previously unexplored geometry and that is assembled by a metal ion, and that it is disassembled by a reducing agent.

developing a new approach to the design and synthesis of protein cages.
the rational design of protein cages, and in particular with the control of their assembly and disassembly.
the rational design of protein assemblies.
